SELECT d.draft_id AS draftId, d.title, LEFT(d.content, 20) AS preview, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachments a WHERE a.draft_id = d.draft_id AND a.usage_type = 'attachment') AS attachCnt, d.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM drafts d WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.slot_no ASC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT attachment_id AS attachmentId, file_name AS originName, file_size AS fileSize, file_url AS fileUrl FROM attachments WHERE draft_id = #{draftId} AND usage_type = 'attachment' ORDER BY attachment_id ASC
